rationale: Steven is building TinyHumans AI, a consumer AI product focused on private, local-first deployment with brain-inspired memory systems, while Sid is an engineer at Fractal Analytics with strong Python and JavaScript skills and experience shipping developer tools and side projects. Steven's conviction that personal AI should be UI-first and accessible (not developer-only) aligns well with Sid's hands-on approach to building user-facing applications, making them natural collaborators on the engineering and product execution side of an AI consumer product.
intro_message: Steven Enamakel, meet Sid Kurra — you're both builders focused on shipping consumer-facing products with clean engineering, and Steven's work on local-first personal AI could benefit from Sid's experience shipping polished applications in Python and JavaScript.
